# `indicator/liveTip`

A live tick amends the newest point and nothing behind it. `applyTipToLastPoint`
performs exactly that substitution, which is what keeps a live series from rewriting history it has
already drawn.

## Example

```ts
import { applyTipToLastPoint, type LiveTip } from 'lightweight-magic-charts';

declare const series: readonly { readonly value: number }[];
declare const tip: LiveTip;

export const withTip = applyTipToLastPoint(series, tip);
```

## Exports

- **`applyTipToLastPoint`** · value · `<T>(series: readonly T[], tip: LiveTip) => readonly T[]`
